landing.heroSubtitle: Understand what you know, identify what you need, and get a learning path that adapts as you grow.
landing.paradoxTitle: Training without measurement is just activity.
landing.paradoxSubtitle: Civil service departments invest billions in learning platforms, yet officers remain uncertain of their true competency gaps and readiness for national priorities.
landing.paradoxCard1Desc: Skill levels are self-declared on surveys with zero empirical validation, leading to misplaced assignments and misaligned training.
landing.paradoxCard2Desc: Over 2,000 unranked modules leave learners overwhelmed, defaulting to familiar subjects rather than addressing critical cadre gaps.
landing.paradoxCard3Desc: Post-training completion certificates measure attendance, not verified mastery, skill retention, or practical operational readiness.
landing.howSubtitle: A deterministic measurement engine connected to adaptive learning and live iGOT Karmayogi catalog discovery.
landing.step1Desc: Map your cadre context, designation, analytical toolstack, and mandated role benchmarks.
landing.step2Desc: 18-item scenario-based evaluation measuring true applied statistical capability.
landing.step3Desc: Mathematical delta calculation against the mandated Level 3 Proficient benchmark.
landing.step4Desc: Live integration with Sunbird iGOT Karmayogi catalog prioritizing highest-impact modules.
landing.step5Desc: Post-course assessment recalibrates scores and unlocks next cadre proficiency milestones.
landing.whySubtitle: Built specifically for India's Official Statistical System (MoSPI / NSSTA).
landing.whyPillar1Desc: No hallucinated scores. Competency ratings are computed via deterministic psychometric algorithms, never guessed by LLMs.
landing.whyPillar2Desc: Every generated assessment item undergoes rigorous multi-stage automated validation before human review.
landing.whyPillar3Desc: Gemini AI assistant strictly grounded in your verified dossier, active gaps, and official curriculum context.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join the national statistical capacity building initiative under Mission Karmayogi.
landing.footerNotice: VYREN is a competency measurement and adaptive learning intelligence prototype developed for national capacity building.

helpGuide.title: How to Use VYREN
helpGuide.supportingText: From professional context to demonstrated competency.
helpGuide.intro: VYREN uses your professional context to personalize your competency diagnostic, identify measurable skill gaps, recommend relevant learning, and continuously update your competency profile as you demonstrate new capabilities.

step1.title: Create your profile
step1.desc: Tell VYREN about your role, department, responsibilities, tools, experience and learning goals.
step1.distinction: This information provides professional context for personalization. It does NOT by itself establish your measured competency.

step2.title: Take your competency diagnostic
step2.desc: Complete your personalized baseline assessment. VYREN uses your professional context to determine which competencies and difficulty levels the diagnostic should target.

step3.title: Understand your skill gaps
step3.desc: Your assessment responses are evaluated using VYREN's deterministic competency model to identify measured competency levels and priority gaps against the requirements associated with your role.

step4.title: Follow your personalized learning path
step4.desc: VYREN recommends relevant learning based on your identified competency gaps, role requirements and available learning resources, including relevant iGOT Karmayogi resources where available.

step5.title: Learn & assess
step5.desc: Complete assigned learning activities and demonstrate your knowledge through assessments and quizzes where applicable.
step5.distinction: Completing a course alone does not automatically establish mastery. Demonstrated performance matters.

step6.title: Recalibrate & improve
step6.desc: As you demonstrate new knowledge and skills through subsequent assessment performance, VYREN updates your competency profile and can refine future learning recommendations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: A quick guide to how VYREN measures competency, recommends learning and tracks progress.

q1.question: What is VYREN?
q1.answer: VYREN is a competency intelligence platform that helps identify workforce skill gaps, recommend relevant learning and track competency development over time.

q2.question: Why does VYREN ask about my role and responsibilities?
q2.answer: Your professional context helps VYREN understand which competencies are relevant to your work and personalize your diagnostic and learning journey.

q3.question: Does my self-reported experience determine my competency level?
q3.answer: No. Self-reported experience provides contextual information and helps calibrate assessment difficulty. Your measured competency is determined by demonstrated performance.

q4.question: How is my competency score calculated?
q4.answer: Your assessment responses are evaluated using VYREN's deterministic competency model. Scores are calculated from demonstrated performance across competency-linked assessment items.

q5.question: Why did VYREN recommend a particular course?
q5.answer: Recommendations are based on identified competency gaps, required competency levels for your role and relevant learning resources available through the platform.

q6.question: What is iGOT Karmayogi?
q6.answer: iGOT Karmayogi is the Government of India's learning ecosystem. VYREN can use relevant iGOT learning resources as part of personalized learning recommendations.

q7.question: Will my competency level change after I complete a course?
q7.answer: Learning completion itself does not automatically prove mastery. VYREN uses subsequent demonstrated assessment performance to recalibrate your competency profile.

q8.question: Can I retake an assessment?
q8.answer: This depends on the assessment and workflow configured by your organization. When reassessment is available, VYREN can use new demonstrated performance to update your competency profile.
